opportunities.title: Authors' Contingency Fund

amount.raw: Grants range in value and are designed to meet immediate need

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to all professional authors resident in the UK or British citizens (including fiction writers, illustrators, literary translators, scriptwriters, poets, journalists and others) whose author-related activities make up a substantial amount of their annual income. Not open to editors, copywriters, or those with salaried income for writing. Membership of the Society of Authors not required. Previous recipients must wait four full calendar years before reapplying.
opportunities.summary: Small, short-term hardship grants to authors in financial difficulty to help them in moments of crisis (e.g. lost income, project shortfalls, illness, home changes, one-off expenses).

opportunities.title: Authors' Foundation

amount.raw: Grants are usually between £2,000-£3,000; Great Britain Sasakawa Grant is one grant of £2,000 annually

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to writers previously published or with a contract for their project with a commercial UK publisher or producer; for book projects must have a non-contributory contract; for script projects must have had a sole-authored work professionally performed or be under contract. Hybrid and self-published books not eligible. Previous recipients must wait four years before reapplying.
opportunities.summary: Grants to help develop a work-in-progress (fiction, non-fiction, poetry, script projects) for research, travel or other expenditure, in addition to any publisher's advance.

opportunities.title: K Blundell Trust
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to British authors under the age of 40, British by birth and currently resident in the United Kingdom, who have had a previous work (of which they are the sole author) published with a commercial UK publisher. Hybrid/self-published books not eligible. Previous recipients must wait four years before reapplying.
opportunities.summary: Work-in-progress grants for British authors under 40 whose work aims to increase social awareness (fiction, non-fiction, poetry and script projects). Currently closed and will re-open for applications in 2027.

opportunities.title: Society of Authors' Access Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to all authors (anyone who creates work for publication, broadcast or performance) who meet the SoA membership criteria; membership not required. Open to UK and Irish residents and British and Irish citizens. One grant per calendar year.
opportunities.summary: Grants for travel, subsistence, childcare or access needs to enable authors to attend events, residencies, and retreats. Currently closed and expected to re-open for applications in 2027.

opportunities.title: Strachey Trust Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to all authors (per SoA criteria for Full Membership, though membership not required) who are UK resident or British citizens, working on a specific full-length literary project with a strong likelihood of publication. One application per calendar year; successful applicants must wait four years before reapplying.
opportunities.summary: Grants to enable authors to travel to a UK or Republic of Ireland archive or collection to research manuscript material for a specific full-length literary project likely to be published.
